title: Beware: this app offers free trial but charges immediately
body: I downloaded this app 15mins ago, went through the questionnaire and agreed to a 7 day FREE trial. Next screen was to sign up for a subscription, of which I was offered 50% discount on annual subscription. I want the free trial first, but there is no way to get past the subscription page without selecting an option. I did this knowing any payment wails need my authorisation … how wrong I was!! Even though I cancelled without approving the credit card payment, it was processed by the app anyway. And not with the subscription to start in 7 days, no it starts immediately. A total scam and nothing short of theft!! No chance to cancel within the trial as stated when you agree to the trial period and cancelling in App Store gives no option to ask for refund of the amount paid, just cancels the renewal set for 2025.

title: Good idea but requires more work
body:
The app looks nice and could be a good benefit for its subscribers but currently it’s very limited and not flexible enough.
There are few routines (e.g. 6 for workouts, 3 for studies) that are almost non-adjustable. I wanted to customize my weekly workout routine by replacing aerobics (which I’m not interested in) by tennis etc., however it’s not possible. The only changes you could make is selecting week days and setting goals for this specific activity. As a result instead of using templates you have to make your routines from the very scratch.
I hoped that AI for cleaning routine would be a good basis for creating my own routines but it doesn’t work properly as well. When answering questions I indicated I have no pets but still got “wash pet bowls” task, not to mention several repetitive tasks such as “wash dishes” and “was dirty dishes”, etc. 
Honestly I don’t want to spend a lot of time putting together all the tasks I want to do for a day/week/month from zero. I want the app making part of a job. So for me this app is not that useful, although the idea behind it is good.
